thread:
Carmen (CS): Flagging Agora onboarding: their security team just hit an external compliance audit that locked access to their VPC keys during our private deploy run. Errors started ~11:02 AM PT and blocked embedding jobs. Need a clear mitigation and comms plan.
Ilya (SRE): Confirmed: KMS requests return 403 after external audit agent toggled key policy. Private path can't decrypt. We can enable a scoped hosted fallback for the onboarding window (no plaintext export) or pause jobs. Fallback ETA ~30m once customer approves.
Noah (AE): High priority—this customer's procurement/renewal is synced with the audit. Any prolonged delay risks the pilot. Keep message concise and reassure about security controls.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-5307 created. Severity: P2. Notifying on-call and compliance.
Carmen (CS): Draft message to Agora (please edit):
> Hi Dmitri  Sorry for the interruption. Your audit agent changed KMS policy which is preventing our private pool from decrypting embeddings. We can: (A) enable a short-lived hosted fallback so your onboarding batch completes now (no plaintext leaves your project; logs and storage remain encrypted), or (B) pause jobs until your audit team restores decrypt permissions. We can also apply a goodwill credit and extend your pilot window by 7 days to offset disruption. Which do you prefer?
Dmitri (Agora Inc.): Thanks Carmen. Please enable the fallback so we can finish the pilot—audit team okay with that as long as you confirm no key material stored. Also send the proposed credit/extension.
Ilya (SRE): Fallback enabled at 11:34 AM PT for project AG-1003 (routing tag applied). Success rate recovered to 97% within 6 minutes. Verified no key material or plaintext written to logs; storage audits clean.
Carmen (CS): Sent confirmation to customer at 11:40 AM PT and offered $2,000 credit + 7-day pilot extension and a 30-min post-incident security review.
Harper (RevOps): Marking AG-1003 as at-risk in renewal tracker until post-incident review completed. I'll capture impact metrics for credit calc.
Ilya (SRE): RCA notes in draft: root cause = external audit policy toggle removed control-plane decrypt grant; mitigations = pre-audit run checklist, allowlist for emergency fallback, and automated preflight policy validation. Posting full RCA by EOD.
Carmen (CS): CS follow-ups: (1) apply credit after impact validation, (2) schedule security review with customer's audit lead, (3) update renewal team after review. Leaving thread open for RCA and final customer note.
notes: Regulatory audit toggled KMS policy during onboarding; hosted fallback used; credit + pilot extension offered; renewal flagged
